entries.mitigation: Keep the bomb targets together on the assigned side and heal each one to full before the 8-second timer expires. After 50% on veteran, expect two targets at once.
entries.notes: Guide evidence records an 8-second heal-to-full window and two veteran targets after 50%; Update 42 confirms Frost Bomb reduces healing taken.

entries.mitigation: Kite the fire bomb away from the group and drop it in the assigned safe area. Do not drag Ignite through the stack.
entries.notes: Fire bombs leave persistent ground danger and apply Ignite; execute cadence accelerates around 25%.

entries.mitigation: Call the charge target and clear the lane. Do not stand between the Wamasu and its target; the path can be lethal on Hard Mode.
entries.notes: Official patch history confirms random-player targeting; guide evidence records path damage and knockback.

entries.mitigation: Interrupt the Archer immediately. Assign ranged interrupts so True Shot never finishes.
entries.notes: Guide evidence says the channel can kill even tanks on veteran and Hard Mode if not interrupted.

entries.mitigation: Check the constellation over your head and enter the matching Control Pathway within 15 seconds or you die.
entries.notes: Radiance lasts 15 seconds and assigns Lion, Gryphon, or Wamasu pathways.

entries.mitigation: Watch the crystal activation order, then destroy them in that same order with ranged light attacks. If you miss it, stop and read the new pattern after the reset.
entries.notes: Veteran uses four crystals and Hard Mode five; a failed sequence resets with a new pattern.

entries.mitigation: Veteran/HM: form the assigned six-player chain. In HM, alternate stacks so nobody with the 30-second Circuit Charge takes the next circuit.
entries.notes: Chain Circuit hits six players on veteran/HM; a repeat hit during Circuit Charge can be fatal.

entries.mitigation: Tank drops the ice pool in the planned spot and moves out immediately. Avoid standing in Arctic Shred unless you enjoy receiving significantly more damage for 10 seconds.
entries.notes: Arctic Blast targets the tank and leaves a 10-second Arctic Shred debuff zone.

entries.mitigation: Spread to your assigned crater spots, then block or dodge the Sunburst impact and move out of the Sizzling Crater immediately.
entries.notes: Inferno targets every player; Sunburst can be blocked or dodged and leaves ramping Sizzling Crater damage.

entries.mitigation: Have the assigned off-tank or healer take the taunt at the threshold. The isolated player stays away from Ansuul while the group kills the Essence Manifestation to clear the lethal aura.
entries.notes: Manic Phobia targets the taunting player; touching Ansuul's Avulse aura before the Essence dies is fatal.

entries.mitigation: Run out of the red zone, complete the maze, attune, and send the portal team immediately. If nobody enters Vanton's side encounter, Ritual Blast wipes the raid.
entries.notes: The Ritual occurs at 80/60/40%; Hard Mode requires the whole group to run the maze.

entries.entry_name: Vanton Torment Timeout — Ansuul the Tormentor
entries.mitigation: Finish the active Torment side encounter within 3 minutes. If it is still alive when the timer expires, Neural Takeover wipes the group.
entries.notes: Update 46 explicitly sets a three-minute Torment completion timer.

entries.mitigation: Stay mostly still in healing. In HM, the two Poisoned Mind targets separate from each other while remaining inside group healing coverage.
entries.notes: Poisoned Mind grows for 10 seconds; HM can apply two at once.

entries.mitigation: Take Sunburst away from the group and place the Afterburn crater at the edge. Do not rely on a roll dodge to avoid Ansuul's impact.
entries.notes: Guide evidence distinguishes Ansuul's Sunburst from Chimera's: it leaves Afterburn and is not avoided by roll dodge.

entries.mitigation: Avoid the ring of fire mines and roll-dodge the central explosion. Do not let Wrack stun you into the blast.
entries.notes: Wrathstorm mines apply Ignite and the explosion can be roll-dodged.
